tower.environments.v1alpha1.InstanceSpec.description: InstanceSpec is the instance tower wants on its target.

diskGolden.description: The Golden its disk is cloned from; empty is a blank disk.

exposePorts.description: Ports others on its network reach it at.

image.description: A container's image, a reference by digest in tower's registry; or a VM's base image by name, as Blueprint.base_image names it, such as "ubuntu-24.04".

kind.description: InstanceKind is what an instance runs as.

network.description: The workstream network it joins, and its name there.

runState.description: RunState is whether an environment should be running. Stopped keeps its disk.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.InstanceStat.description: InstanceStatus is what the provider reports.

phase.description:
InstancePhase is what the provider last saw of the instance.

- INSTANCE_PHASE_GONE: It existed and is not there any more.

processesRunning.description: How many processes started in it (StartProcess) are running. tower never stops for idleness a box whose instance runs one.

usedDisk.description: What its disk holds beyond the golden it was cloned from.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.Resources.description: Resources is a shape, as quantities; an empty one takes tower's default.

disk.description: Such as "40Gi"; a disk only grows.

tower.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

tower.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

tower.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

description: Instance is a container or a VM on one target: what a provider makes real. tower's controllers make one for each box and machine; hostd reads those of its own target and nothing about what they are for. It carries no secret: values reach an instance only through commands (docs/decisions/secrets.md).
title: Instance
